boundary: This groups proved odd-prime reduced cubic shapes into local-image theorem schemas. It does not prove the local-image theorem, compute local Selmer images, prove local conditions, prove a Selmer rank bound, or prove any lambda-family exclusion.

schemas.model_shape: y^2 = x*(x-r)^2 with r a local unit and tangent squareclass 1
schemas.required_theorem: compute the 2-isogeny local squareclass image for the nodal unit-double-root model with tangent squareclass 1
schemas.unit_hypothesis: r is nonzero modulo ell and r is a square modulo ell

schemas.model_shape: y^2 = x*(x-r)^2 with r a local unit and tangent squareclass -1
schemas.required_theorem: compute the 2-isogeny local squareclass image for the nodal unit-double-root model with tangent squareclass -1
schemas.unit_hypothesis: r is nonzero modulo ell and r has squareclass -1 modulo ell

schemas.model_shape: y^2 = x^2*(x-s) with s a local unit and tangent squareclass 1
schemas.required_theorem: compute the 2-isogeny local squareclass image for the nodal zero-double-root model with tangent squareclass 1

schemas.model_shape: y^2 = x^2*(x-s) with s a local unit and tangent squareclass -1
schemas.required_theorem: compute the 2-isogeny local squareclass image for the nodal zero-double-root model with tangent squareclass -1
